title: Kong Climb deployment diagram
description: How Kong Climb runs: one Cloudflare Worker with static assets, no database and no secrets. The browser runs the whole game; the Worker checks the sign-in and the invite-only role, and serves the files.

nodes.name: Player's browser
nodes.description: Runs the whole game and keeps the best score in localStorage.

nodes.name: Cloudflare edge
nodes.description: Runs the Worker on icelander.net/games/recreations/arcade/kong-climb*, ahead of the games hub's less specific route.

nodes.name: kong-climb Worker
nodes.description: worker/index.ts: the sign-in and role check on every request, then the page and its files from ./dist.

nodes.name: icelander.net login service
nodes.description: accounts.icelander.net, in the icelander.net repository (accounts/): who holds the host's site_session cookie and their games: roles. The Worker reaches it only through a service binding.

artifacts.name: index.html, kong.css and kong.js
artifacts.description: The page and its stylesheet, copied into dist/, and the game script bundled from src/ by esbuild.

artifacts.name: Worker script
artifacts.description: The fetch handler, bundled by wrangler.

relationships.description: HTTPS: the page and its assets.
Service binding ACCOUNTS (entrypoint Internal): every request needs a signed-in player holding games:recreations.
